title_sq: Tek Viva Rezidence, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Planimteri Te Rregullt!!
description_sq: Tek Viva Rezidence Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Planimteri Te Rregullt!! Apartamenti me siperfaqe bruto 76.7 m², nga te cilat 53.3 m2 neto, 9.6 m2 siperfaqe perbashket dhe 13.8 m2 verande , ndodhet ne katin e 8 dhe organizohet ne korridorin shperndares, dhomen e ndenjes bashke me kendin e gatimit, dhoma matrimoniale, te dyja me dalje ne verande dhe tualeti. Apartamenti aktualisht eshte ne faze karabina dhe pritet te perfundoje brenda 2-vjetesh. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode. Kompleksi ne te cilin ndodhet apartamenti dallohet per cilesine e punimeve dhe eshte nje nder komplekset me te mira te zones.
title_en: At Viva Rezidence, 1+1 apartment with regular layout for sale!!
description_en: At Viva Rezidence, a 1+1 apartment with a regular layout is for sale!! The apartment with a gross area of ​​76.7 m², of which 53.3 m2 net, 9.6 m2 common area and 13.8 m2 veranda, is located on the 8th floor and is organized in the distribution corridor, living room with kitchenette, matrimonial room, both with access to the veranda and toilet. The apartment is currently in the construction phase and is expected to be completed within 2 years. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life. The complex in which the apartment is located stands out for the quality of the works and is one of the best complexes in the area.
